verdict.rationale: Warp's marketing states that tax registrations, filings, and payments are handled automatically across all 50 states, and that Warp Agent runs payroll and handles tax notices. Together these cover the core of multi-state payroll with per-state registration. Missing for 10: explicit documentation of per-state withholding calculation, in-depth first-party docs (evidence is homepage marketing only), and independent or hands-on corroboration.
